title: Observe the zone of a programmatically registered cron task
summary: The new London cron overload and the explicit trigger fired at 08:00Z in July and 09:00Z in January, including with a Tokyo context clock.

change.description: Add a Runnable, expression and ZoneId overload to ScheduledTaskRegistrar. The pre-existing CronTask constructor path supplies a comparison available on both revisions.

notes: The caller reads the recorded trigger, invokes its runnable, uses a fixed date and zone, and checks that disabled registrations leave the task alone.
